pages.title: Euler's Formula
pages.text: $(thing)Euler's Formula$()$(br2)Raise e to an imaginary power and it does not grow: it turns, round a circle, as cos θ + i sin θ. A cheaper way to the Imaginary Unit.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): e, Complex Analysis.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 e Crystal, 1 π Crystal.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): e^(iωt) goes once round the unit circle and back. Write how long one turn takes, the period T.
